# sleep_sleeper (Ephemeral Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the ephemeral resource. This can be any random string value since this provider stores no information

### Optional

- `close_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from the Close call. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `open_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from the Open call. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `renew_delay` (String) The number of seconds that the Open call will return. This is used by the caller system to know at which interval should call Renew
- `renew_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from the Renew call. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `string_in` (String, Sensitive) An optional field that will be used to be returned by the ephemeral resource in the `string_out` attribute

### Read-Only

- `string_out` (String, Sensitive) Value that will be generated by the ephemeral resource. It uses the information passed into `string_in` or if that is missing, it will use the value of the `id` attribute
